mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate predicts a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as investors anticipate rate hikes to curb inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > +0.5% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of similar inflation acceleration events (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor claims coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market interprets stronger labor demand.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly > previous month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >50% of analogous labor strength episodes (rolling IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 (goods demand) and RSAFS (services demand) over the next month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to dual softening in consumption.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous month AND RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative in >60% of similar dual-demand contractions (p < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) accompanied by a decline in HOUST (housing starts) over the next 5 days signals supply-side weakness, leading to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month AND HOUST < previous month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >80% of analogous contractions (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 3% for three consecutive months (no tightening), the S&P 500 is expected to post a positive 20-day forward return as markets anticipate continued easing.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-positive in >50% of such episodes (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE (unemployment) above 4.5% in the following month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate recession risk.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in <30% of similar spikes (p > 0.7).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS over a 60-day window predicts a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as deflationary expectations encourage risk-on sentiment.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < previous 60 days AND FEDFUNDS < previous 60 days
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >50% of such dual declines (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months and INDPRO shows a monthly increase, the S&P 500 is expected to have a positive 20-day return as labor market strength supports production growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% for 2 months AND INDPRO > previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-positive in >70% of analogous regimes (p < 0.01).
